## What's new

**AI on a model works without a database.** In 1.5.0 the model's own AI entries (*Design with AI*, *Review the model*, *Suggest indexes*, *Normalize*, *Add audit columns*) and the assistant panel answered "Connect to a database to chat about it" when the model was not linked to a connected database. A model is text, and a chat about it needs none.

- With a model in front, the assistant's chat belongs to the model: it is kept with the model's file, found in the chat history, and the box asks what should change in the model.
- Such a chat gets the model's text and nothing else: no connection is opened and the assistant has no database tools, so nothing from a database can reach a chat about a file.
- A model linked to a database you have open keeps the chat about that database, as before; when that database is closed or its AI is off, the model's tasks still work on the model's text.
- A model too long to send whole is told so, and the assistant then describes changes instead of offering a "complete" model that would replace yours with its beginning.

**Also**

- `dbmastermind-mcp` 1.5.1 on npm: `npx -y dbmastermind-mcp --url 'postgres://user@host/db'`, listed in the MCP registry as `io.github.eLh0m3r0/dbmastermind-mcp`.

Everything new in 1.5 is in the [1.5.0 notes](https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/tag/v1.5.0).

Updates itself on Windows (installer), macOS and Linux (AppImage). The [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) version updates through the Store.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| Windows, signed by Microsoft | [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) |
| Windows, no installation | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.1-win-x64-portable.zip`: unzip and run `DB Mastermind.exe` |
| Windows installer (no admin, updates itself) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.1-win-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows for IT (per machine) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.1-win-x64.msi` |
| Windows via Scoop | `scoop install https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/latest/download/db-mastermind.json` |
| macOS | `…-mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) / `…-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel), or `brew tap elh0m3r0/db-mastermind https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind && brew install --cask db-mastermind`. First launch: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (the app is not notarized yet) |
| Linux | `DB-Mastermind-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (updates itself; needs FUSE 2, `libfuse2t64` on Ubuntu 24.04) or `.deb` |
| MCP server and command line | `npx -y dbmastermind-mcp` · `npx -p dbmastermind-mcp dbm` |
